crossRefs.note: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

translations.web: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
translations.bsb: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy.
translations.kjv: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
translations.asv: And behold, there was before him a certain man that had the dropsy.
